objectives: Name the four kinds of notarial fees and when each applies.
Determine the material interest for any common act.
Calculate a proportional fee from the tariff, in leva and in euro.
Prepare a correct bill and explain who owes the fees.
Add the entry fee, the local tax and VAT to give a client a full estimate.

cards.front: Name the four kinds of notarial fees.
cards.back: Ordinary, proportional, by time, and for drafting and checking (Art. 90–94 ЗННД).

cards.front: When is a fee charged on the higher of price and tax assessment?
cards.back: When they **differ**: always the higher (Art. 96(3) ЗННД).
The **nominal value** of the secured claim (Art. 97(1) ЗННД).
**30%** of item 8, at least 30 лв. (item 10 ТНТ).
**Half of item 10**, at least 25 лв. (item 12 ТНТ).

cards.front: Fee for checking a client's draft?
cards.back: **Half** of the fee; the other half if the same notary certifies within one month (Art. 94 ЗННД).

cards.front: Is an oral consultation charged when it relates to a charged act?

cards.back: When the act is **performed**; for a circumstantial verification, when the request is **filed** (Art. 88 ЗННД).

cards.front: Who is liable for the fee when several persons ask?
What can the notary do about unpaid fees?
cards.back: Ask for an **order for payment** regardless of the amount (Art. 89(3) ЗННД).

cards.front: Entry fee at the Registry Agency?
cards.back: **0.1%**, at least **10 лв. (5.11 €)**; deletions and notes: half.

cards.front: Range of the local tax on purchase?
cards.back: **0.1% – 3%**, set by the municipal council (Art. 47(2) ЗМДТ).

cards.front: Additional fee for an act outside the office in working hours?

quiz.question: What is the item 8 fee for a material interest of 200,000 €?
A flat is sold for 70,000 €; its tax assessment is 85,000 €. What is the material interest for the fee?
quiz.explanation: The higher of the price and the tax assessment.

quiz.question: What is the material interest for a right of use granted for life?
options: The market price of the property
quiz.explanation: If no term is set, the rent for 3 years.

quiz.question: The office drafts a sale deed at the parties' request. What may it charge for the drafting?
options: The item 8 fee for the draft, in addition to the fee for the deed
quiz.explanation: For a draft deed, the fee provided for the certification is charged (item 20, letter "а"); a check of a client's own draft costs half.

quiz.question: A client asks for a written legal opinion that takes 1 hour 10 minutes. How is it charged?
options: Two hours at the item 15 rate
quiz.explanation: A started hour counts as a full hour.

quiz.question: Two clients asked the notary for a contract; only one paid half. What can the notary do?
options: Claim the rest from either client, as they are jointly liable
Claim only from the one who did not pay
Ask the Notary Chamber to pay
quiz.explanation: Several persons who owe fees are jointly liable.

quiz.question: The office used a wrong material interest and undercharged. What is the procedure?
options: A new bill for the correct fee, made within 7 days of discovering the error
Ask the client to send a gift

quiz.question: Is VAT charged on the entry fee of the Registry Agency?
quiz.explanation: VAT applies to the notary's service, not to state fees and taxes.

quiz.question: A gift of a house from a woman to her brother's son. Which tax range applies?
The notary certifies a power of attorney at a client's home in the same town, at 19:00. What additional fee applies under the tariff?
What is the minimum entry fee?
quiz.explanation: The Registry Agency tariff sets 0.1%, at least 10 лв.

quiz.question: How are amounts in leva in the tariff read since 2026?
options: Converted at 1.95583 and rounded to the cent
